item.title: Beyond the KV cache: Training and serving i14’s Laplace 3B linear attention model on AWS Trainium2 with native PyTorch
item.description: Learn how i14 trained and served Laplace 3B, a linear attention model, on AWS Trainium2 using native PyTorch. Its recurrent state stays fixed at 29.5 MB per sequence regardless of context length, avoiding the growing key-value cache of transformer models and keeping serving memory predictable. — AWS Machine Learning（原文；译文待补）

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.305
item.description: What's changed Added sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces so sandboxed commands on Linux can create user namespaces (Chromium, rootless podman); this lets them get around the sandbox's file protections Added CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS so unattended retry mode ( CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG ) notices a usage limit that was lifted before its reset Fixed every request failing on Vertex, Bedrock and oth — Anthropic Claude Code 官方版本（原文；译文待补）

item.title: Work management context for AI agents with Smartsheet MCP on AWS
item.description: The Smartsheet Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server lets AI agents read, update, and act on live work management data. This post shows two ways to connect it on AWS: Amazon Quick for business teams and Kiro for developers, so your agents can work with Smartsheet without switching tools. — AWS Machine Learning（原文；译文待补）

item.title: From data to decisions: Conversational supply chain intelligence with Amazon Quick and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: Enterprise supply chains are data-rich but insight-poor, with the data to decide scattered across ERP, monitoring, procurement, and email. This post shows how Amazon Bedrock AgentCore exposes those systems as a governed tool layer, and how Amazon Quick turns them into one conversational experience for business users, with a deploy-it-yourself walkthrough. — AWS Machine Learning（原文；译文待补）

item.title: Fine-tuning GPT-OSS-20B for multilingual reasoning on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
item.description: Learn how we fine-tuned GPT-OSS-20B for multilingual reasoning on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, and how to decide between supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with GRPO. SFT took reasoning-language accuracy from 22% to 100%, and GRPO added measurable gains where headroom existed. — AWS Machine Learning（原文；译文待补）

item.title: How Octave built a secure multi-tenant AI foundation on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Octave built a secure, multi-tenant AI foundation on Amazon Bedrock, using Cohere Embed v4 for embeddings and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore for isolated agent execution, to power a Complaint Triage Assistant that searches 2 billion regulated documents without crossing tenant boundaries. — AWS Machine Learning（原文；译文待补）

item.title: Access OpenAI GPT models on Amazon Bedrock from Canada with cross-Region inference
item.description: Canadian organizations can now access OpenAI GPT-5.6, GPT-6, and GPT-6.1 models on Amazon Bedrock from the Canada (Central) and Canada West (Calgary) Regions using cross-Region inference. This post covers the models and inference profiles, how to set up permissions, and how to invoke them with the Responses, Chat Completions, and Converse APIs. — AWS Machine Learning（原文；译文待补）

item.title: Discover tools at runtime with AWS Agent Registry
item.description: Hardcoded tool wiring breaks down as an agent's catalog grows from a handful of tools to hundreds. This post walks through a runtime Discover, Instantiate, Execute loop built on AWS Agent Registry, where an orchestrator discovers MCP servers and A2A agents through semantic search at runtime instead of compiling every tool at build time. — AWS Machine Learning（原文；译文待补）

item.title: Securing AI agent identity with X.509 PKI on AWS
item.description: Learn how to secure multi-agent AI systems with cryptographic identity using Keyfactor EJBCA and AWS services. This reference architecture combines signed request envelopes, user-signed delegation assertions, RFC 8693 audience-scoped tokens, and real-time OCSP revocation to prove agent identity and prevent request forgery across agent-to-agent and MCP tool calls. — AWS Machine Learning（原文；译文待补）

item.title: Called to serve: Tech, research, and positive impact
item.description: Lab Director Chris White has worked on research challenges with real-world implications—from new approaches to wartime data analysis to tools for combating human trafficking. He talks to program manager Weishung Liu about the influences that led to the work and more. The post Called to serve: Tech, research, and positive impact appeared first on Microsoft Research . — Microsoft Research（原文；译文待补）

item.title: How Eon built multi-cloud investigation with an MCP Gateway on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: Learn how Eon replaced per-tool credentials and local MCP processes across AWS, GCP, and Azure with a single authenticated Amazon Bedrock AgentCore gateway, giving more than 100 developers and autonomous agents unified access to production investigation and cutting new-engineer onboarding from two days to two minutes. — AWS Machine Learning（原文；译文待补）

item.title: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI on AWS with Denodo and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: Build a governed semantic layer for agentic AI on AWS with the Denodo Platform and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. It federates Amazon Aurora, Amazon Redshift, and an on-premises PostgreSQL database into a single customer 360 view an agent queries in VQL, with identity propagation and row- and column-level access control enforced at the semantic layer. — AWS Machine Learning（原文；译文待补）

item.title: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI on AWS with Strategy Mosaic and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: The third post in our semantic-layer series builds a customer 360 across Amazon Redshift and Amazon Aurora with Strategy Mosaic, exposes it to a Strands agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore through the Mosaic MCP server, and enforces per-user row and column security end-to-end. — AWS Machine Learning（原文；译文待补）

item.title: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI on AWS with AtScale and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: The third post in our semantic-layer series builds a governed customer 360 model on Amazon Redshift with AtScale, then exposes it to a Strands agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore through the AtScale MCP server. Identity propagation, RBAC, row security, and full query audit are enforced at the semantic layer, not the prompt. — AWS Machine Learning（原文；译文待补）

item.title: Amazon SageMaker JumpStart: 2026 year-to-date in review
item.description: Amazon SageMaker JumpStart onboarded over 100 new models from 30 providers in the first three quarters of 2026. This recap covers the model-onboarding highlights and JumpStart enhancements, including the simplified Model Hub, pre-configured deployment options, and Hugging Face deep link integration. — AWS Machine Learning（原文；译文待补）

item.title: Pegasus 1.5 from TwelveLabs is now available in Amazon Bedrock
item.description: TwelveLabs Pegasus 1.5 is now available in Amazon Bedrock. The video language model turns long-form video into structured, timestamped metadata: define the moments that matter and get every matching segment back as JSON, with new video segmentation, multimodal prompting with reference images, and on-the-fly processing of up to two hours of video. — AWS Machine Learning（原文；译文待补）

item.title: How Deepgram optimized voice AI at scale with AWS Trainium
item.description: Deepgram worked with the AWS Forward Deployed Engineering team to port its Nova-3 speech-to-text model to AWS Trainium2 for offline batch inference. This post covers porting to the AWS Neuron stack, kernel-level tuning, a data-parallel Rust runtime, and the throughput and cost results on batch transcription. — AWS Machine Learning（原文；译文待补）

item.title: Push-based KV transfer to improve TTFT and TPOT for disaggregated inference in vLLM
item.description: vLLM's prefill-decode disaggregation splits LLM inference across engine instances but must transfer the KV cache between them. This post introduces a push-based NIXL connector that moves transfer coordination off the critical path, delivering up to 3x better TTFT and 30% better TPOT in benchmarks on Amazon EC2 P5en instances with AWS EFA. — AWS Machine Learning（原文；译文待补）

item.title: Improve TTFT for multi-turn agentic workloads with bi-directional KV transfer in vLLM
item.description: Multi-turn agentic workloads reprocess growing conversation context each turn, driving up latency. See how bi-directional KV cache transfer lets prefill and decode nodes reuse previously computed context across turns, cutting time to first token by up to 1.6x for Qwen3-32B and 3.3x for GLM-5-FP8 on Amazon EC2 P5en instances with EFA. — AWS Machine Learning（原文；译文待补）
